purpose: Give YADO a kernel-owned broad public web discovery/read channel without a fixed hostname allowlist.
network_guards: reject any non-global resolved IPv4 or IPv6 answer
pin TLS socket to a validated public IP
retain original hostname for TLS SNI and Host
revalidate every redirect target before transport
reject URL credentials and non-443 ports
bound redirects, response bytes, timeouts, and discovered links
accept text, JSON, and XML-family response bodies only
semantic_boundary: BROAD PUBLIC HTTPS READ/DISCOVERY ONLY. NO PRIVATE NETWORK ACCESS, AUTHENTICATION BYPASS, CREDENTIAL USE, EXTERNAL WRITE, DOWNLOADED-CODE EXECUTION, OR UNBOUNDED AUTONOMOUS CRAWLING.
